name: B10-0190/2026 – After § 3 – Am 3
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the enforcement of the Digital Markets Act
part_text: 3a. Expresses its deep concern about the Commission’s intention to establish an EU-US tech ‘dialogue’ despite repeated threats from the Trump administration and sanctions imposed on individuals, including a former EU Commissioner; recalls that the EU’s digital regulatory autonomy is non-negotiable, in terms of both implementation and enforcement;
